items.rationale: Lightning overvoltage damage to an appliance is covered under 2.3.3/4.2.4 within the EUR 5,000 sub-limit (not reached). Nothing is established about surge protection, so no 50% reduction; standard-grade replacement per 7.1.9, priced near the Case 9 level.
Carriage/delivery of replacement property is not a repair cost under 7.1.8(b) and is outside 5.2.2.
Fitting, installing and commissioning replacement property is excluded under 7.1.8(c).

Surge-damaged appliance covered under 2.3.3 and 7.1.1(c), within the sub-limit; no reduction as nothing is established about a protective device. Standard-grade replacement at the Case 9 reference level (517-616).

items.description: Property and liability damage to electronics
items.rationale: Bundles property with liability handling without separate pricing and arises from a service arrangement; excluded under 3.1.4, 3.1.5 and 7.1.8(f).

items.description: Property and liability damage to electronics - service order
items.rationale: Charge for placing an order under a service/liability arrangement; excluded under 3.1.5 and 7.1.8(f).
Attendance charge on an invoice where no work is indemnifiable; excluded under 7.1.8(d).
